basis: Manually checked selected-mode geometry and channel links in the pinned description.xml files. These are structural targets, not proof of DMX or rendered behavior.

cases.evidence: Base contains Yoke/Body/Beam; channels 10,11 target Pan on Yoke and 12,13 target Tilt on Body.
Base contains 19 Wash BeamLED nodes and AuraPlate with BeamType None. Pan targets Yoke and Tilt targets Head, both authored as generic Geometry rather than Axis.
Base has 25 LED references under Head, with break offsets 19,23,...115. Each instantiates one LED beam with RGBW at relative addresses 1..4. LED is a template, not a second stage root.
Base16 LED 3 contains 16 references to 16/3 Pixel Beam with offsets 1,4,...46. RGB uses relative channels 1..3; Dimmer has no physical offset.
112/117ch Body has 16 tube and 32 plate references; both templates are single Beam nodes. Plate RGB begins at 6,7,8 with reference offsets 1,4,...94; tube dimmer begins at 102 with offsets 1..16.
Base has four separate Yoke/Head/Beam chains. Pan/Tilt pairs are at 7/8,10/11,13/14,16/17. Master RGBW on Base must later be combined with each beam's local dimmer.
